scope: Tool-assisted discovery inside existing Radar; source registration is not an authenticated feed or continuous collector

queries.query: {category} customer reviews using every day bought another
new product demonstration now possible easier workflow release
{category} switched stopped using cancelled replaced review
{category} customer demand restock wait time availability new use

query_rules: Use relevant date/recency filters and inspect actual publication dates; query generation does not establish coverage.
Vary semantic equivalents and source domains; do not require exact phrase matches or stock terminology.
No saved ticker, company whitelist, personality or AI-only theme may substitute for these four checks.
Follow promising sources to an original observation/release; a press summary does not establish firsthand usage.
Carry missed source/category coverage before advancing rotation; Core discovery remains independently required.

sources.purpose: repeated use, repurchase, switching and abandonment
sources.method: authorized public page or search discovery; follow original posts
sources.cadence: each run using relevant communities, not one subreddit only
sources.limits: Probe returned a page crawled three weeks earlier; not verified intraday coverage. Selection, affiliate and self-report biases. Do not bypass blocks or assume Reddit API credentials.
sources.fallback: Search accessible non-investment product/practitioner forums; record exact source and date.

sources.method: public chronological index, follow original demo and discussion
sources.limits: Index was read; linked products were not independently tested. Maker claims are not organic adoption, upvotes are not customers.
sources.fallback: Product launch index or original release page; disclose gap.

sources.method: public launch index, then original product/release/demo
sources.cadence: capability source option; rotate beyond software
sources.limits: Launch and promotional ecosystem; ranks/votes are not sales, paid usage or independent confirmation. Index access is not API access.
sources.fallback: Original manufacturer/developer release or accessible hands-on demonstration.

sources.purpose: product-specific demand, availability, restocking and practitioner change
sources.method: discover a current manufacturer/retailer/public industry page from the rotating category; record canonical URL
sources.limits: Use same SKU, seller, geography and comparison window. Availability is not sell-through. No paid datasets or purchased access are authorized.
sources.fallback: Comparable public channel/practitioner source; missing comparable baseline stays unknown.

sources.purpose: gaming category discovery and targeted product follow-through
sources.method: public index and linked product pages/reviews
sources.limits: Index opened; no numeric series or adoption claims validated. Rank, concurrent use and sales are distinct metrics. Preserve chart definition and geography.
sources.fallback: Original game/store release plus accessible player discussion.

sources.purpose: original demonstrations, practitioner reviews and supplementary Dumb Money disclosures
sources.method: resolve actual channel; use verified uploads playlist/feed when accessible; search is fallback
sources.cadence: relevant due sources and expert pass; not a substitute for independent discovery
sources.limits: No assumed API key, quota or transcript access. Episode title/description proves neither transcript review nor a particular cohost's trade.
sources.fallback: Public channel/episode index; record metadata-only or transcript-unavailable.

sources.method: accessible public chart/export when actually available
sources.limits: Sampled, normalized search interest, not absolute users or sales; use compatible query/topic/geography/timeframe and record method changes.
sources.fallback: Other observable evidence; do not invent Trends values.

sources.purpose: optional source discovery when legitimately accessible
sources.cadence: opportunistic, never required for an all-source completion claim
sources.limits: No assumed TikTok Research API eligibility or unrestricted X/Instagram data; no evasion, credentials search, proxies or paid providers.
sources.fallback: Original publicly accessible evidence elsewhere, preserving same-origin dedup.

sources.purpose: reuse existing raw/evidence records as supplementary inputs
sources.method: discover supported authenticated Investor tools at runtime; read only actual supported schemas
sources.cadence: bounded preflight or continuation, not a prerequisite for public discovery
sources.limits: Code-read audit found personality/stock queries and known-entity/date filters. Do not apply its score or filtered output as the sole discovery gate. Connector directory lookup returned no MikeInvestor integration in this implementation session.
sources.fallback: Native web discovery plus existing authorized manifest/Reporting Journal; no dummy ticker or overwritten Core case.

runtime_storage: existing authorized run manifest/Reporting Journal, never private records in this public register
